name: CTR9 component of Paf1/RNA polymerase II complex
pathways: transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CTR9 encodes RNA polymerase-associated protein CTR9 homolog. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II complex binding. It participates in chromatin organization and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.
